asset.label: Thompson Health Region: symbol, name and tagline, vector reconstruction
asset.sourceLocator: Rebuilt from the region’s letterheads of 9 September 1999, 9 June 2000 and 1 November 2001, in the City of Merritt’s council agendas (PDF pages 118, 110 and 53); the symbol’s colours from a 2003 Environment Canada publication
asset.dateNote: The letters date sightings of the logo from 1999 to 2001, not its adoption.
asset.notes: A cross split by a winding white path, five pointed cut-outs across its top, beside “Thompson Health Region” in serif and “A Path to Better Health” in italic, in black as on the region’s letterheads.
asset.fidelityNote: A vector reconstruction, not original artwork, which has not been found. The symbol (a cross with a winding white path and five pointed cut-outs at the top) is redrawn as smooth curves over three letterheads of 1999–2001; their scans carry about 112 px of real detail, so its exact curves and corner radii are not recoverable, and the damaged upper-left edge of the 1999 copy is restored from the later two. The name is outlined EB Garamond (weight 500) and the tagline Nimbus Roman Italic, fitted to the letterheads’ ink; the original typefaces are not identified, and these set a little heavier than the letters’ thin print.

asset.label: Thompson Health Region: colour symbol with name and tagline, composite reconstruction

asset.dateNote: The letters date sightings of the logo from 1999 to 2001, not its adoption.
asset.notes: The same arrangement with the symbol in its two colours, teal below and ochre in the top upright, and the name and tagline in black.
asset.fidelityNote: A vector reconstruction, not original artwork, which has not been found.
